stats.humidity: Humidity statistics for the selected period

display.title: Display test
display.subtitle: Manually test one of the daytime screens.
display.copy: Test a daytime screen at night or the night screen during the day. The selected view is forced regardless of the time. Turning the test off restores the automatic schedule.
display.mode.label: Choose display mode
display.active: Test active: {mode}. This view is forced regardless of the time.
display.auto: The automatic day/night cycle is running normally.
display.error: Could not connect to the clock. Please try again.
weather.title: Weather display style
weather.label: Weather display style
weather.currentLetters: The text abbreviation (3 letters) is displayed.
weather.error: Could not change the setting. Check the connection to the clock.
lamp.title: LED lamp
lamp.subtitle: Turn the entire matrix into an adjustable light source.
lamp.copy: Starts only when you press the button. Brightness controls the LED driver output, while pixel density gradually dims individual LEDs.
lamp.densityHint: A lower value turns off some LEDs in the dot pattern.
lamp.on: The lamp is on. The clock and other screens are temporarily paused.
lamp.off: The lamp is off. The clock is running normally.
lamp.saveError: Could not change lamp mode. Check the connection to the clock.
lamp.readError: Could not read the lamp status from the clock.
audio.title: Music visualizer
audio.subtitle: Bluetooth audio · device: Malina
audio.copy: Pair your phone with Malina and select it as the audio output. When music starts playing, the matrix automatically displays the audio spectrum. Malina does not play sound through a speaker.
audio.playing: ♪ Audio received — the equalizer is running on the matrix.
audio.pair: Malina is ready to pair. Select it in your phone’s Bluetooth settings.
message.title: Matrix message
message.copy: Enter a message, choose how it should appear, and send it to the clock.
message.sent: Done. The message is now displayed on the matrix.
message.stopped: Message stopped. The clock is back.
